text:
Drew O'Connor is having the kind of start that turns a player into a trade rumor. Two goals and five points in 19 games, Manny Malhotra calling out his penalty troubles publicly (per Canucks Army), and Vancouver Hockey Daily and Pro Hockey Rumors floating him as a target. Yahoo Sports has him focused on turning the season around.

The case for patience is mostly in the details. He's an undrafted Dartmouth product with top-end speed, faster than 96% of the league by NHL Edge, and Evolving-Hockey noted his teammates last season sat in the bottom 4% by impact, which makes his raw numbers look worse than his own play. Vancouver is about four points of expected goal share better with him on the ice than off it. His shooting (8%) is below where he'd settle.

The case against is that he doesn't create much: our range has him at 11 to 22 goals over a full season after 17 last year, and our "plays like" comparisons note that chances against pile up with him on. He's an alternate captain on a team that may sell. Fixing the penalties is the first step.
headline: O'Connor needs a turnaround
